name: IHG One Rewards Traveler Credit Card

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available for basic coordination. No medical or evacuation cost coverage on this no-annual-fee card.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (secondary coverage). Must decline CDW at rental counter.

otherCredits.name: 3rd Night Free
otherCredits.notes: When redeeming IHG One Rewards points for 3+ night stays, receive the 3rd night free. Effectively reduces a 3-night reward stay by 33%.

rewards.travelRate: 17x at IHG Hotels & Resorts (5x from card + 10x from IHG Rewards program + 2x Silver Elite bonus)

otherBonusCategories.category: Grocery stores and other monthly bills

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.5–0.8¢ per IHG point; best redeemed for IHG hotel stays

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Visit chase.com or call the number on back of card

travelPerks: No annual fee — free to hold forever
Complimentary IHG One Rewards Silver Elite status
3rd night free on reward redemptions of 3+ nights
17x IHG points on IHG hotel stays
3x points at restaurants, gas stations, and grocery stores
Secondary rental car collision damage waiver
Points don't expire as long as card is active
bestFor: Occasional IHG guests who want to earn hotel points at no cost and take advantage of the 3rd-night-free benefit with zero annual fee
